description:

Building Devin is just the first step—our hardest challenges still lie ahead. If you’re excited to solve some of the world’s biggest problems and build AI that can reason on real-world tasks, apply to join us.

Role Mission

Post-training is the critical bridge between raw model capability and a system that is actually useful, safe, and effective in the real world. You will shape how our agents learn by iterating on training recipes, evaluations, and alignment methods that directly determine what Devin and our future systems can do. This role blends deep research and hands-on engineering. We don't distinguish between the two.

What You'll Accomplish

•
Post-Training Recipe Development: Iterate on the full stack of datasets, training stages, and hyperparameters that determine model behavior. Measure how choices compound across evals and production performance, not just isolated benchmarks.

•
Evaluation Design and Integrity: Build evals that actually capture what matters. The loop never ends: define, optimize, realize the gaps, and rebuild. You'll be responsible for making numbers go up and making sure the numbers mean something.

•
Deep Understanding: When training produces results that don't make sense, you dig until you understand why. The goal isn't just to fix it; it's to carry that understanding forward to the next problem.

•
Alignment and Agent Behavior: Apply and advance techniques like RLHF, RLAIF, and constitutional approaches to shape how agents reason, act, and collaborate with humans in long-horizon tasks.

•
Scaling and Exploration: Measure how performance scales with data and compute, and develop new methodologies when existing ones hit ceilings. We expect both rigor and invention.

Exceptional Candidates Have Demonstrated

•
A track record of advancing ML systems through post-training, alignment, or related methods: RLHF, RLAIF, preference modeling, reward learning, or equivalent

•
Strong fundamentals in probability, statistics, and ML theory. The ability to look at experimental data and distinguish real effects from noise and bugs

•
Evidence of original contributions: publications at top venues, open-source impact, or equivalent industry results

•
Experience with large-scale distributed training and the debugging that comes with it

•
Systems-level thinking: not just model optimization, but understanding how training pipelines, data, and evaluation interact

•
Comfort with ambiguity and fast-moving research environments where priorities shift quickly

•
We care more about demonstrated capability than credentials. A PhD is one signal among many.

Resources & Environment

•
Small, highly selective team where research and product move together; prototypes reach real deployment quickly

•
Compute is not a constraint: large allocations with training jobs routinely running across thousands of GPUs from day one

•
The environment rewards speed, autonomy, and technical depth with minimal process overhead; this is one of the most competitive and fast-moving problems in AI

•
Everything needed to operate at frontier scale from day one.

We are an applied AI lab building end-to-end software agents.

We're the makers of Devin, the first AI software engineer.

Our team is extremely talent-dense. Among our founding team, we have world-class competitive programmers, former founders, and leaders from companies at the cutting edge of AI including Scale AI, Palantir, Cursor, Waymo, Tesla, Lunchclub, Modal, Google DeepMind, and Nuro.

Building Devin is just the first step—our hardest challenges still lie ahead. If you’re excited to solve some of the world’s biggest problems and build AI that can reason on real-world tasks, apply to join us.

Why are we hiring for this role?

Cognition is growing quickly across teams and international offices. Every new hire should feel welcomed, prepared, and ready to contribute from day one. That takes someone who cares about the employee experience and stays ahead of every detail behind it.

We need someone to own onboarding from offer acceptance through a new hire’s first week. Those early days shape how someone feels about joining Cognition, so you’ll bring warmth and care to every interaction while staying ahead of the details. You’ll build the onboarding program and first-week sessions, communicate proactively with new hires, and coordinate background checks, I-9 verification, HR system setup, travel, laptop deliveries, and systems access. You’ll work closely with Recruiting, IT, managers, and office teams, checking in directly with each new hire to make sure they have what they need. As we grow, you’ll keep improving the checklists and handoffs that make a great first week possible.

What does success look like?

•
New hires feel expected and cared for. They know where to go, what to expect, and who to ask for help before their first day.

•
Background checks, I-9 verification, employee records, and other required onboarding steps are completed accurately and on time.

•
First-week travel is arranged, laptops arrive when needed, accounts work, and schedules are clear. You check directly with each new hire rather than assuming everything is set.

•
Give executive hires a white-glove and personal onboarding experience

•
Immigration and visa needs are identified early, routed to the right people, and tracked through the next step.

•
Recruiting, IT, managers, and office teams know what they own. You spot delays, follow up proactively, and resolve issues before they affect a new hire’s start.

•
Trackers, checklists, and communications stay current as hiring grows.

What are the critical competencies?

•
Proactive coordination. You can juggle many starts, owners, and deadlines without losing track of the details. You anticipate what could go wrong, follow up before someone has to ask, and keep each start moving.

•
Care for the employee experience. You know a warm welcome is built through both thoughtful communication and reliable execution. You make new hires feel expected, check that they have what they need, and respond quickly when something isn’t working.

•
HR onboarding operations. You can manage background checks, I-9 verification, employee records, and HR system setup accurately and on time. You handle sensitive information with care.

•
Cross-functional follow-through. You keep Recruiting, IT, managers, office teams, and immigration partners aligned. You make ownership clear and stay with an issue until it’s resolved.

•
Process improvement. You spot recurring gaps in a checklist, handoff, or message and fix them. You make onboarding more reliable while keeping it personal.

•
Low ego, high ownership. You’re as willing to improve a workflow as you are to find a delayed laptop or help a new hire access their account. You care that the first week works.

Equal Opportunity

Cognition is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities throughout the hiring process - please let us know if you need any.

title: ABM/Enterprise Demand
description:
We are an applied AI lab building end-to-end software agents.

We're the makers of Devin, the first AI software engineer.

Our team is extremely talent-dense. Among our founding team, we have world-class competitive programmers, former founders, and leaders from companies at the cutting edge of AI including Scale AI, Palantir, Cursor, Waymo, Tesla, Lunchclub, Modal, Google DeepMind, and Nuro.

Building Devin is just the first step—our hardest challenges still lie ahead. If you’re excited to solve some of the world’s biggest problems and build AI that can reason on real-world tasks, apply to join us.

We're looking for a leader of Enterprise Demand to build the demand engine behind Cognition's enterprise growth.

You'll own how Cognition creates demand across our highest-priority verticals and major strategic accounts, while building repeatable enterprise motions that can scale beyond them.

You'll determine where Cognition has the strongest opportunity to win, whether that's a specific industry, major account, use case, account cohort, technology environment, or strategic segment, and build the campaign strategy to go after it.

This is broader than traditional ABM.

You'll work across Product Marketing, Paid, Web, Field Marketing, Sales, RevOps, and other GTM teams to turn market opportunity into coordinated campaigns that generate qualified enterprise pipeline.

This is a highly hands-on role. You'll build the strategy and execute it: identifying audiences and accounts, developing campaign concepts and offers, building vertical and account-based programs, launching tests, analyzing pipeline, and continuously improving how Cognition creates enterprise demand.

What You'll Do

Build Cognition's Enterprise Demand Strategy

•
Identify and prioritize the verticals, major strategic accounts, account cohorts, use cases, and market opportunities where Cognition has the strongest opportunity to win.

•
Build a deep understanding of Cognition's ICP, buying committees, intent signals, pain points, technical environments, buying triggers, and enterprise buying journeys.

•
Develop differentiated GTM motions for priority industries rather than applying a generic enterprise playbook across the market.

•
Understand the regulatory, technical, operational, and business considerations that shape buying behavior within key verticals.

•
Partner with Sales leadership to identify a focused set of major accounts that warrant bespoke 1:1 programs.

•
Determine when the right motion is a vertical campaign, strategic-account program, 1:few cluster, use-case campaign, or broader enterprise demand motion.

•
Continuously identify new pockets of opportunity as Cognition's product, customer base, and market evolve.

Build Vertical & Major-Account Plays

•
Build repeatable demand programs for Cognition's highest-priority verticals.

•
Translate customer outcomes, industry dynamics, technical requirements, and buyer pain into vertical-specific campaigns, offers, proof points, and conversion experiences.

•
Own bespoke 1:1 programs for major strategic accounts, working closely with Sales to understand the account, buying committee, current initiatives, internal priorities, and potential entry points.

•
Develop account-specific campaign concepts, offers, executive experiences, customer proof, and digital journeys designed to create engagement inside those accounts.

•
Build 1:few programs around clusters of similar accounts where a common industry, use case, technology environment, business problem, or buying trigger creates leverage.

•
Use vertical and account-level insight to identify the right mix of personalization and scalability.

•
Turn successful vertical and major-account motions into playbooks that can be replicated across adjacent accounts, segments, and markets.

Build and Run Enterprise Campaigns

•
Own a continuous portfolio of campaigns targeted at Cognition's highest-value enterprise audiences.

•
Develop the campaign hypothesis: who we're targeting, why they should care, why now, what we're offering, and how we'll reach them.

•
Create integrated campaign plans across paid, web, content, field, direct outreach, customer proof, and other relevant channels.

•
Run campaigns across 1:1, 1:few, and 1:many account strategies.

•
Build campaigns around verticals, use cases, buyer pain points, competitive opportunities, customer outcomes, and strategic market moments.

•
Build repeatable campaign frameworks that allow winning motions to scale.

•
Move quickly from idea → campaign → pipeline → learning.

Turn Customer Proof Into Demand

•
Work closely with Product Marketing, Sales, Account teams, and customer-facing teams to understand where Cognition is creating meaningful business outcomes.

•
Turn those outcomes into campaign ideas, account plays, proof points, vertical narratives, and enterprise stories.

•
Identify opportunities to replicate customer success across similar accounts, industries, and use cases.

•
Ensure customer proof is embedded wherever it can materially improve demand creation and conversion.

•
Build feedback loops that continuously turn customer adoption and outcomes into new demand motions.

•
Use major customer wins to open adjacent accounts within the same vertical or account cluster.

Orchestrate the Demand Engine

•
Act as the campaign owner across Cognition's priority enterprise motions, including vertical campaigns and major-account programs.

•
Partner with Product Marketing to develop the industry narratives, customer proof, competitive positioning, and account-specific messaging required for each motion.

•
Partner with Paid Growth to determine how campaigns should be distributed and scaled across target audiences and accounts.

•
Partner with Web & CRO to build vertical-specific, campaign-specific, and account-specific digital experiences where appropriate.

•
Partner with Field Marketing and Events on executive programs, dinners, workshops, and experiences tied to priority verticals and major accounts.

•
Partner with Sales to align on target accounts, account strategy, buying signals, outreach, and follow-up.

•
Partner with RevOps to ensure campaigns are measurable from account engagement through opportunity creation and pipeline.

•
Keep cross-functional teams focused on the same target, campaign hypothesis, and business outcome.

Build a High-Velocity Testing Program

•
Continuously test new enterprise audiences, verticals, account segments, messages, offers, channels, and campaign formats.

•
Build clear hypotheses and success criteria for each motion.

•
Test different approaches to vertical marketing, major-account engagement, personalization, and orchestration.

•
Scale campaigns that create meaningful pipeline and stop those that don't.

•
Identify which combinations of account, message, offer, and channel consistently produce the strongest opportunities.

•
Build institutional knowledge around how Cognition wins enterprise demand.

Build Repeatable Enterprise Plays

•
Turn successful campaigns into repeatable GTM playbooks.

•
Develop motions around specific industries, major-account archetypes, use cases, buyer problems, competitive opportunities, and account segments.

•
Document what works without turning the organization into a process-heavy machine.

•
Make it increasingly easy for Cognition to enter a new segment, vertical, or account cluster and rapidly understand how to create pipeline there.

•
Build scalable frameworks for moving from a single successful account or customer outcome to broader market penetration.

Optimize for Enterprise Pipeline

•
Measure success based on qualified enterprise pipeline and revenue impact.

•
Track performance by campaign, vertical, account, segment, audience, offer, and channel.

•
Use account-level engagement and pipeline data to continuously refine targeting and campaign strategy.

•
Understand which verticals and account cohorts are generating the strongest business outcomes.

•
Partner with RevOps to understand which programs are creating incremental opportunity—not merely generating activity.

•
Help determine where Cognition should invest its next dollar, next campaign, and next strategic motion.

Work AI-Natively

•
Use AI aggressively for market research, account research, segmentation, campaign development, personalization, analysis, and execution.

•
Build workflows that allow enterprise campaigns to operate with exceptional speed and leverage.

•
Use AI to accelerate major-account research, buying committee analysis, vertical insight, and campaign development.

•
Continuously look for ways AI can fundamentally improve how account-based and enterprise demand generation is done.

What Success Looks Like

You'll know you're succeeding when:

•
Cognition has a consistent pipeline of high-quality enterprise campaigns in market.

•
Priority verticals have clear, differentiated demand strategies and repeatable GTM motions.

•
Major strategic accounts have thoughtful, coordinated programs that create meaningful engagement and opportunity.

•
We're systematically identifying and penetrating high-value account segments.

•
Winning campaigns become repeatable plays rather than one-off successes.

•
Customer outcomes are continuously being turned into new demand.

•
Sales and Marketing have a clear shared understanding of which verticals and accounts we're targeting and why.

•
We're learning quickly which combinations of audience, message, offer, and channel create pipeline.

•
Enterprise campaigns generate measurable qualified pipeline—not just engagement.

•
Cognition develops a repeatable advantage in how we create demand within strategic enterprise accounts and industries.

What We're Looking For

•
7+ years of experience in enterprise B2B demand generation, ABM, integrated campaigns, growth marketing, or GTM.

•
A track record of building campaigns that generated meaningful enterprise pipeline.

•
Experience developing and executing vertical-specific GTM programs.

•
Experience building 1:1 programs for major strategic accounts, as well as 1:few and 1:many motions.

•
Deep understanding of complex B2B buying committees and enterprise sales cycles.

•
Strong campaign instincts: you know how to connect an audience, insight, message, offer, and distribution plan.

•
Strong analytical ability and comfort measuring performance at the account, vertical, and pipeline level.

•
Comfortable owning both strategy and execution.

•
Experience partnering closely with Sales, Product Marketing, RevOps, Paid, Field Marketing, and Web teams.

•
Strong understanding of how customer outcomes and proof can be turned into new demand.

•
A strong operator: you've built things from zero, scaled what worked, and killed what didn't.

•
Able to translate complex technical products into enterprise business outcomes.

•
Excited about AI and interested in using it to fundamentally change enterprise demand generation.

The Ideal Candidate

You're not an ABM program manager.

You're a builder who looks at the market and asks: Where can we win, which accounts matter most, and what campaign will make that happen?

You can identify a vertical opportunity, build a repeatable campaign around it, and scale it across the market.

You can also take a single major strategic account, understand its priorities and buying committee, and build a thoughtful 1:1 program designed to create real engagement and opportunity.

You understand accounts and enterprise buying committees, but you don't confuse personalization with strategy.

You can orchestrate multiple teams around a campaign, launch quickly, look at the pipeline data, and decide what to do next.

Your goal isn't to create the most sophisticated ABM program.

Your goal is to create enterprise pipeline.

Equal Opportunity

description:

The Role

We're looking for a leader of Paid & Digital to build and scale Cognition's paid demand engine.

You'll own the strategy and execution behind how we use paid distribution to reach the engineers, technical leaders, and enterprise buyers shaping the future of software development.

This goes well beyond managing ad platforms.

You'll determine where Cognition should invest, which audiences we need to reach, what we should put in front of them, and how we turn that attention into qualified enterprise pipeline.

You'll operate across established channels like paid search, LinkedIn, YouTube, Reddit, and other social platforms, while continuously identifying new opportunities across technical publications, newsletters, communities, creators, sponsorships, and emerging channels.

This is a highly hands-on role. You'll build the strategy and execute it: launching campaigns, analyzing performance, developing audiences, reviewing search queries, testing creative, evaluating new channels, and deciding where the next dollar should go.

What You’ll Do

Build Cognition's Paid Demand Engine

•
Own Cognition's paid acquisition and distribution strategy with a focus on generating qualified enterprise pipeline.

•
Determine the right channel mix, investment strategy, audiences, offers, and campaign architecture as we scale.

•
Build a clear understanding of where our highest-value audiences spend their time and how we can reach them.

•
Allocate budget dynamically based on performance and opportunity rather than fixed channel assumptions.

•
Build the systems, processes, and measurement framework required to scale paid investment significantly.

•
Partner with sales, operations, and sales enablement to ensure leads are qualified and are effectively worked.

Own Paid Media

•
Own strategy and execution across paid search, LinkedIn, YouTube, Reddit, Meta, X, and other relevant platforms.

•
Build sophisticated audience and account strategies around enterprise segments, personas, intent, and buying stage.

•
Capture high-intent demand while creating demand among accounts that may not yet be actively searching.

•
Continuously optimize campaigns based on pipeline quality and downstream business outcomes—not just clicks, leads, or platform-reported conversions.

•
Maintain deep expertise in the platforms and stay close enough to execution to identify opportunities others miss.

Expand Paid Distribution Beyond Traditional Advertising

•
Identify and test new channels where technical and enterprise audiences spend attention.

•
Build partnerships across relevant newsletters, technical publications, developer and enterprise communities, podcasts, creators, influencers, and other emerging distribution channels.

•
Evaluate opportunities based on audience quality, enterprise relevance, scale potential, economics, and ability to test.

•
Build a repeatable process for finding, testing, measuring, and scaling new sources of demand.

•
Continuously challenge where Cognition should be spending its next dollar.

Build a High-Velocity Experimentation Engine

•
Run a continuous pipeline of experiments across channel × audience × message × creative × offer × format × landing experience.

•
Develop clear hypotheses and success criteria before launching tests.

•
Test fundamentally different approaches rather than only optimizing existing campaigns.

•
Quickly scale what works and shut down what doesn't.

•
Build a culture where experimentation velocity increases as the paid program grows.

•
Track investment impact throughout the sales journey.

•
Turn individual campaign learnings into insights that improve the broader Demand Gen strategy.

Build the Creative Testing System

•
Develop a systematic approach to paid creative experimentation.

•
Identify which messages, narratives, customer proof, product capabilities, and formats resonate with different audiences.

•
Partner with Product Marketing and Design to maintain a consistent pipeline of new creative concepts.

•
Test across video, static, product-led creative, customer proof, technical content, executive perspectives, and emerging formats.

•
Use performance data to inform the next generation of creative rather than simply requesting more assets.

Develop Offers That Create Demand

•
Partner with Web/CRO, Product Marketing, and the broader Demand Gen team to determine what we should put paid distribution behind.

•
Test different offers across stages of the enterprise buying journey—from product experiences and technical content to customer proof, benchmarks, assessments, executive content, and direct sales engagement.

•
Identify when the existing offer isn't working and help develop something better.

•
Match the right offer to the right audience rather than sending every campaign to the same conversion path.

Optimize for Enterprise Pipeline

•
Measure success based on qualified enterprise pipeline and downstream business impact.

•
Partner with RevOps to understand performance from impression → account engagement → opportunity → pipeline.

•
Understand performance by audience, account segment, channel, campaign, offer, and creative.

•
Develop clear frameworks for CAC, pipeline efficiency, marginal spend, and incrementality.

•
Use data to determine where Cognition should increase, decrease, or reallocate investment.

Work AI-Natively

•
Use AI aggressively across research, audience development, campaign creation, creative iteration, analysis, and optimization.

•
Build workflows that allow the paid program to operate with exceptional speed and leverage.

•
Experiment with emerging AI-native advertising, discovery, and distribution channels as they develop.

What Success Looks Like

•
Paid becomes a predictable and scalable source of qualified enterprise pipeline.

•
Cognition has a clear understanding of which channels, audiences, messages, offers, and creative combinations generate the highest-quality opportunities.

•
We're consistently discovering and validating new distribution channels.

•
Experimentation velocity increases over time.

•
Creative is continuously refreshed based on real market feedback.

•
Budget can scale materially without sacrificing pipeline quality or efficiency.

•
We can confidently explain where the next incremental dollar should go—and why.

•
Paid insights are helping the broader marketing organization understand what resonates with the market.

You Should Be

•
8+ years of experience in paid acquisition, growth marketing, digital marketing, or demand generation, ideally in a high-growth B2B technology company.

•
Experience managing and scaling significant paid media budgets.

•
Deep hands-on expertise across major advertising platforms, particularly paid search and LinkedIn.

•
Strong understanding of enterprise B2B buying journeys and account-based marketing.

•
Experience testing channels beyond traditional paid media.

•
Strong creative instincts and experience building systematic creative testing programs.

•
Exceptional analytical ability and comfort connecting media performance to pipeline and revenue.

•
Comfortable owning both strategy and execution.

•
Experience working closely with Product Marketing, Design, Web/Growth, RevOps, and Sales.

•
Strong commercial judgment and the ability to distinguish meaningful business outcomes from attractive marketing metrics.

•
Highly hands-on. You're comfortable opening an ad account, digging into campaign performance, writing a brief, evaluating a media opportunity, launching a test, and deciding what to do next.

•
Excited about AI and interested in using it to fundamentally change how performance marketing operates.

The Ideal Candidate

You're not looking to inherit a media plan and optimize it.

You want to figure out where Cognition's next million dollars of efficient growth should come from.

You're equally comfortable scaling a proven channel, killing an underperforming campaign, testing an unconventional distribution partner, developing a new offer, or digging into the data to understand why a campaign generated leads but no pipeline.

You combine the analytical rigor of a performance marketer with the curiosity of a growth marketer and the commercial instincts of an enterprise demand generation leader.

And you want to build, not just manage.

Equal Opportunity
